// ConnectionStrings: Leave Recon empty and the portal asks for a server on /setup, tests it,
writes it to recon.settings.json beside the application and creates the
database itself. Set it here (or from an environment variable, or a
secret store) and that value wins and is never overwritten — which is
what a real deployment should do.

// Scheduler: Enabled = false disables the in-process scheduler for this whole
deployment and cannot be overridden from the portal, so a deployment
can be certain nothing fires. The portal's own switch, on the
Schedules screen, stops and starts it without a restart.
